from collections import Counter, deque

def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); bg=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen=set(); comps=[]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c]==bg or (r,c) in seen: continue
            comp={(r,c)}; seen.add((r,c)); q=deque([(r,c)])
            while q:
                y,x=q.popleft()
                for yy,xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w and grid[yy][xx]!=bg and (yy,xx) not in seen:
                        seen.add((yy,xx)); comp.add((yy,xx)); q.append((yy,xx))
            comps.append(comp)
    motif=max(comps,key=len)
    r0=min(r for r,c in motif); r1=max(r for r,c in motif); c0=min(c for r,c in motif); c1=max(c for r,c in motif)
    ar,ac=(r0+r1)//2,(c0+c1)//2
    offsets=[(r-ar,c-ac,grid[r][c]) for r,c in motif]
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for comp in comps:
        if comp==motif or len(comp)!=1: continue
        r,c=next(iter(comp))
        for dr,dc,v in offsets:
            y,x=r+dr,c+dc
            if 0<=y<h and 0<=x<w: out[y][x]=v
    return out
PY
